admission.justification: Major-only counts and display-state precedence alone conceal what each compact unit contains; child disclosure alone does not fix a child-inclusive denominator or canonical readiness confusion, so the existing progress invariant and the new detail invariant together retain compact truthful progress and accessible hierarchy.

guarantee: The task-tool answer, sidebar, master row and task-page summary use major-step progress units and marks, while begun/done children promote only the unfinished major’s display state. The same major/child hierarchy remains fully readable in cached pointer-rest dot details and the task-page nested list without new requests or dot focus stops; progress-bar rows do not gain tooltips, and display never rewrites canonical task state or closeout readiness.
title: Compact major progress with complete child reading
